name: How long does front door installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does front door installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard front door installations can be completed within one day. This includes removing the old door and frame, preparing the opening, installing the new pre-hung door unit, and applying exterior trim and weatherstripping. More complex projects, such as widening an entryway, adding structural supports, or installing custom-sized doors, may require additional time. We provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard front door installation usually takes one day, including removal and setup. More complex projects might require additional time.
